config.command: Command used to start the internal DSH background service. Executed as-is; the extension appends no arguments.
config.url: Fallback address of an external DSH service, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3080. Used only when no internal DSH is running and that address answers.
config.autoConnect: Connect automatically when VS Code starts: the internal DSH is preferred, the external Url is the fallback, and the internal DSH is started when neither is available. When off, only the connect buttons are shown.
config.supervisorIdleSec: How many seconds the internal DSH background waits before shutting down automatically after the last VS Code window closes. Recommended: no less than 10 seconds.
config.diffLayout: How edit tool calls render their change: single column or side-by-side.
config.diffLayout.auto: Adaptive: single column in a narrow panel, side-by-side when wide.
config.language: Language of the chat UI. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
config.fontSize: Font size of the chat UI in integer pixels (>= 8). `0` follows the VS Code font size.
config.questionBatch: How many questions of one questionnaire to show at once. A questionnaire with more questions than this is asked one question at a time. `0` always shows every question at once.
config.turnProcessThreshold: Fold a finished turn's consecutive tool calls (subagent dispatches included) once it reaches this many. 0 = never fold; 1–2 = always fold.
config.agentPreset: Agent preset new sessions run. Empty follows the DSH server's own default preset. Only applies while the server allows choosing presets.
